use_case: AI support assistant on the customer portal chat and text-message support line: answers outage, billing, and plan questions, reads the customer's account, opens repair tickets
vendor_or_model: Billing platform vendor's AI support assistant add-on (generative large language model service from a third-party model provider)
data_categories: Customer messages; account data (balance, plan, invoices, outage status, tickets); for home phone accounts, call history (CPNI)
consequential_decision_category: None (customer service; no decisions about credit, service eligibility, or disconnection)
human_in_the_loop: Owner handles every escalation, credit, dispute, and account change; reviews 20 transcripts a month
applicable_laws: FCC CPNI rules 47 CFR 64.2010(a), (c), (f) and 64.2011 (C-COMMUNICATIONS-R01); FTC Act Section 5 for broadband statements; Fla. Stat. 501.171 if credentials are exposed
status: In production with conditions (turned on 2026-05-04; call history off on the text line since 2026-07-22)
